survivalfly.configuration.enableMod.tool: Enables the Survival Fly mod (for your client/singleplayer/LAN worlds).
survivalfly.configuration.crouchFlight.t:
Allows crouching while flying without descending (CTRL + SHIFT).

§cThis feature §c§odoes work on servers §r§cthat don't have the mod installed, but please be careful and read the server rules before using this feature.
survivalfly.configuration.permissions.to:
Choose who can use /flight commands

This only applies if you are hosting a singleplayer world. To change the permissions on a server, use the /permissions command or install §aLuckPerms§r§f.

§aAnyone → §7anyone can use /flight§r§f

§dModerator → §7players that bypass spawn protection can use /flight§r§f

§5Gamemaster → §7players that have higher authority, such as permission to use command blocks, change gamemode, change difficulty, etc. can use /flight§r§f

§cAdmin → §7only operators can use /flight. Admins can also change the flight of others
survivalfly.configuration.flightSpeedMod: Determines if regular players (who do not have a LuckPerms permission node or are a server operator) can change their flight speed.
survivalfly.configuration.friendlyFlight:
Prevents the player from using flight if they have taken any damage within 20 seconds.

§bPlayers §r§f& §r§aMobs §r§f→ §7prevent flight from player and mob damage§r§f

§aPlayers Only §r§f→ §7prevent flight from player damage
survivalfly.configuration.elytraFlight.t: Requires the player to wear an elytra to use flight. The elytra's durability will decrement based on the player's flight speed.
survivalfly.configuration.flightExhausti: Makes the player hungry when using flight.
survivalfly.configuration.client.title: Client
survivalfly.configuration.seenWarningMes: Determines if you have seen the disclaimer for Survival Fly.
survivalfly.configuration.serverWarnings: Sends warning messages to the player upon joining a server that does not have Survival Fly installed.
survivalfly.configuration.menuButton.too:
Determines where the Survival Fly menu button should display.

Everywhere → §7in the default position on the pause screen and title screen§r§f

Title Only → §7only on the title screen§r§f

OFF → §7do not display the menu button at all. You should only disable this if you have another way of accessing the menu, via Mod Menu or (Neo)Forge's mod list.
